title: Uruguayan Ancho Chili Stir Fry
description: A spicy and flavorful stir fry inspired by Uruguayan cuisine, featuring juicy ancho chilies and savory adventurous ingredients.

ingredients.name: Stir fry vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as bell peppers, carrots, and broccoli

instructions: Heat the adventure oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the garlic and cook for an additional minute, until fragrant.
Add the ancho chilies and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the uruguayan paprika and stir to combine.
Add the juicy tomatoes and stir fry vegetables, and cook until the vegetables are tender-crisp, about 4-5 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh cilantro.
Serve with your choice of sides, such as rice, beans, or crusty bread.
